output.investigation_summary: The engine reports that transaction TX-0917-00002 is GBP 90.00 higher than the bank entry linked by its end-to-end reference, and its confirmed relationship connects that record to the GBP 90.00 client-balance roll-forward difference for C0007. The available evidence does not provide the corrected transaction amount or posting-level client ledger.

confirmed_findings.claim: The engine reports TX-0917-00002 at GBP 1,480.07 against a reported GBP 1,390.07 bank entry, a GBP 90.00 difference.
confirmed_findings.explanation: RC4-DIRECT reports computed 1,480.07 and reported 1,390.07, identifies TX-0917-00002 as the outlier, and compares it with bank entry BE-GBP-0917-L02. The transaction and bank entry share reference E2E-GBP-0917-L02.
confirmed_findings.title: Transaction and linked bank-entry amounts differ
confirmed_findings.audit_relevance: The amount recorded for the client load does not match the amount on the linked bank entry.
confirmed_findings.establishes: The transaction record reports GBP 1,480.07 and the linked bank-entry record reports GBP 1,390.07. The engine reports a GBP 90.00 difference and identifies the transaction record as out of line.
confirmed_findings.does_not_establish: It does not establish why the transaction record is out of line or what its corrected amount should be.

confirmed_findings.claim: The engine confirms TX-0917-00002 connects EXC-TC06-06 to EXC-TC06-05, with its GBP 90.00 discrepancy equal to C0007's GBP 90.00 roll-forward difference.
confirmed_findings.explanation: The transaction was executed within C0007's 2026-09-16 17:00 to 2026-09-17 17:00 roll-forward window. The engine reports the roll-forward as 36,731.11 against the 36,641.11 snapshot and identifies TX-0917-00002 as the record behind both exceptions and out of line; the direct comparison also links it to bank entry BE-GBP-0917-L02.
confirmed_findings.title: Confirmed transaction lineage connects the two exceptions
confirmed_findings.audit_relevance: The same out-of-line transaction record is identified in both the direct transaction-to-bank comparison and the client balance roll-forward exception.
confirmed_findings.establishes: The engine reports a roll-forward of 36,731.11 against a reported snapshot of 36,641.11, a difference of 90.00, and confirms that this equals the transaction-side discrepancy of 90.00. It identifies TX-0917-00002 as the record behind both exceptions and the record out of line.
confirmed_findings.does_not_establish: It does not establish why the transaction record is wrong; the underlying data-entry, system or process reason is not established.

confirmed_findings.claim: The internal reconciliation record reports a GBP 341,574.46 requirement, GBP 341,484.46 resource and GBP -90.00 difference, while its action text says there was no difference.
confirmed_findings.explanation: These are fields and narrative in the firm's 2026-09-17 internal reconciliation record.
confirmed_findings.title: Internal reconciliation fields and narrative differ
confirmed_findings.audit_relevance: The internal reconciliation record contains inconsistent reporting that should be checked when assessing the firm's reconciliation evidence.
confirmed_findings.establishes: The record contains the stated requirement, resource and reported difference, and its action text states that there was no difference.
confirmed_findings.does_not_establish: It does not establish the correct internal reconciliation result or explain the inconsistency. These pool-level reconciliation fields are not the same measure as the individual transaction-to-bank amount comparison.

confirmed_findings.claim: The supplied-data search for posting-level client ledger records for C0007 returned NOT_FOUND.
confirmed_findings.explanation: SEARCH-03 records a search for the client ledger postings and returned no records.
confirmed_findings.title: Client ledger postings were not found in the supplied-data search
confirmed_findings.audit_relevance: Without posting-level ledger evidence, the client balance movement cannot be independently traced from the supplied postings.
confirmed_findings.establishes: The documented search of the supplied data for posting-level client ledger records returned NOT_FOUND.
confirmed_findings.does_not_establish: It does not establish that such postings do not exist outside the supplied data.

confirmed_findings.claim: The transaction record for the GBP 662.59 spend matches its linked GBP 662.59 settlement line.
confirmed_findings.explanation: The records share transaction ID TX-0917-00010, and the verified link reports their signed amounts as agreeing.
confirmed_findings.title: Spend transaction and settlement line agree
confirmed_findings.audit_relevance: This provides a transaction-to-settlement cross-check for another transaction in the C0007 roll-forward window.
confirmed_findings.establishes: The spend transaction and its linked settlement line each record GBP 662.59.
confirmed_findings.does_not_establish: It does not establish bank movement for this settlement line or resolve the discrepancy involving TX-0917-00002.

hypotheses.possible_explanation: The amount in TX-0917-00002 may be inaccurate due to a data-entry, system or process error.
hypotheses.limitations: The records identify the transaction amount as out of line but do not establish why or provide its corrected amount.
hypotheses.rationale: The transaction record differs from the linked bank entry by GBP 90.00, and the engine identifies the transaction record as out of line; the underlying reason is not established.

contradictory_evidence.description: The linked transaction record reports GBP 1,480.07, while the bank-entry record reports GBP 1,390.07.
contradictory_evidence.same_measure_and_scope: Both records concern the GBP amount for the same load/payment identified by TX-0917-00002 and the shared end-to-end reference E2E-GBP-0917-L02; the amounts materially disagree.

missing_evidence.description: The corrected transaction amount from the transaction system is not available in the supplied evidence.
missing_evidence.expected_source: Transaction system record or audit trail for TX-0917-00002.
missing_evidence.impact: The amount that should replace or explain the recorded GBP 1,480.07 cannot be established.

missing_evidence.description: The search for all C0007 GBP REFUND transactions in the period returned NOT_FOUND.
missing_evidence.expected_source: Transaction records or other source evidence for C0007 GBP refunds during the period.
missing_evidence.impact: The supplied search does not provide refund records to include in a complete review of the client balance movement.

missing_evidence.description: The search for posting-level client ledger records for C0007 returned NOT_FOUND.
missing_evidence.impact: The balance movement cannot be independently traced to ledger postings from the supplied evidence.

open_questions: What amount does the transaction system's corrected record or audit trail show for TX-0917-00002?
Why does the internal reconciliation record's narrative say there was no difference while its reported difference field is GBP -90.00?
Are there client ledger postings or refund records outside the supplied data that would complete the C0007 balance movement?

recommended_next_steps.action: Obtain the transaction-system record and audit trail for TX-0917-00002, including any corrected amount and change history.
recommended_next_steps.rationale: The engine identifies this transaction record as out of line, while the corrected transaction amount is not available.
recommended_next_steps.evidence_needed: Authoritative transaction-system record, amendment history and audit trail for TX-0917-00002.

recommended_next_steps.action: Obtain the posting-level client ledger for C0007 covering the 2026-09-16 to 2026-09-17 reconciliation window.
recommended_next_steps.rationale: SEARCH-03 returned NOT_FOUND, so the supplied evidence does not permit a posting-level trace of the balance movement.
recommended_next_steps.evidence_needed: Client ledger postings with transaction identifiers, amounts, directions and posting timestamps for the window.

recommended_next_steps.action: Confirm the completeness of the supplied transaction data for C0007 GBP refunds during the period.
recommended_next_steps.rationale: SEARCH-02 returned NOT_FOUND; verify whether refund records exist in another source or whether the search scope is complete.
recommended_next_steps.evidence_needed: Authoritative refund transaction records or confirmation of transaction-source completeness for the period.

recommended_next_steps.action: Ask the preparer to substantiate the internal reconciliation's reported fields and narrative against its underlying calculation.
recommended_next_steps.rationale: The same internal reconciliation record reports a GBP -90.00 difference and says there was no difference.
recommended_next_steps.evidence_needed: Underlying reconciliation calculation, source extracts and any review or correction record for the 2026-09-17 GBP reconciliation.
